summary: iter213 — E2E FRONTEND collaudo of the TWO NEW features. Master Gate PIN 1985 → capo-gate-login → email admin@mikilab.de / Mikilab2026! → landed on Capo master console. FEATURE 1 (Riepilogo Squadra Vocale, panel-shift-team): OK. Panel present and open by default. shift-team-call renders with two dept groups: shift-team-dept-panificio (2 ops → Marco·forni, Youssef·impasti) and shift-team-dept-pizzeria (1 op → Ali·pizzaiolo). Per-dept operator counts (2 / 1) match seeded data. shift-team-announce (global) and shift-team-speak-panificio (single dept) both fire without any console/JS exception (TTS is silent in headless as expected). FEATURE 2 (Vista 3D per Operatore, DeptFocus in produzione): OK. Reached the Production zone via rail-operatori, unlocked floor with PinLock digits pin-key-1/9/8/5 (PIN 1985). floor-zone rendered and mohamed-role-select mounted with DeptFocus at the top. dept-focus-picker shown asking 'Who are you?' with three buttons dept-focus-op-Ali / dept-focus-op-Marco / dept-focus-op-Youssef. Click Ali → dept-focus mounts, dept-3d-strip contains a WebGL <canvas> 1230×112 with a live GL context and testid avatar-world-pizzeria (theme=pizzeria); dept-focus-opname='Ali'; task text shows 'Pizzeria · pizzaiolo'. Click dept-focus-reset-op → picker returns. Click Youssef → theme switches to avatar-world-panificio; dept-focus-opname='Youssef'; task 'Panificio · impasti'. Regression: dept-assign panel still present with all 5 dept-pick-* (panificio, pasticceria, pizzeria, laugen, banco). No purple/violet UI, no ErrorBoundary. Console: 401 warnings from /api calls fired BEFORE gate cookie was set (harmless pre-auth polls). One transient 'THREE.WebGLRenderer: A WebGL context could not be created. Reason: Canvas has an existing context of a different type' appeared once when re-mounting the 3D strip during theme switch — the visible canvas keeps rendering, but this is a benign React StrictMode / hot-swap artifact worth cleaning up (see code review).

issues: Same finding as iter212 — floor PinLock digits DO have pin-key-<n> testids (verified working). Kiosk/Briefing modal close X buttons still lack a dedicated testid; automation had to find them via text 'Enter the console' or a svg.lucide-x fallback.

action_items: Optional: guard AvatarWorld3D against double-context creation on theme switch to eliminate the one-shot 'THREE.WebGLRenderer: A WebGL context could not be created. Reason: Canvas has an existing context of a different type' console error observed once when switching pizzeria → panificio (dispose prior renderer/geometry in an effect cleanup, or key the <canvas> by theme so React fully remounts).
Optional: add data-testid=briefing-close / kiosk-close / cyber-trio-close to the X buttons of the SHIFT OPEN briefing and Kiosk Mode modals for deterministic automation (carry-over from iter212).
Optional: pre-auth /api polls emit 401 in DevTools before the Master Gate cookie is set — gate the fetch calls behind an `if (gateOk)` in the client to keep the console tidy.
critical_code_review_comments: ShiftTeamCall.jsx: no loading/empty state distinction between 'still loading' and 'no team today' — a brief flash of shift-team-empty appears on cold mount before the first deptApi.assignment() resolves. Consider a null/loading state.

DeptFocus.jsx: identity is stored in localStorage (mikilab_operator_name) with NO PIN check — anyone on the tablet can pick any name and start recording +qty on that operator's behalf. Consider tying the picker to the same operator PIN used by addProgress.

DeptFocus.jsx: name matching is case-insensitive (good) but exact substring comparison on `operator` field — if two operators share the same first name (e.g. two 'Marco') both assignments will be shown to whichever taps the tile. Consider unique keys or dept-scoped tiles.

AvatarWorld3D: transient THREE 'existing context of different type' on theme swap suggests the renderer isn't being disposed between mounts. Add a return-cleanup in useEffect that calls renderer.dispose()/forceContextLoss() and clears the canvas ref.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — every testid in the request was found and every asserted behaviour verified

(2) click capo-gate-login → fill input[type=email]/type=password → click the button whose innerText matches /accedi|sign in/i (auth modal renders OUTSIDE [data-testid=capo-gate]). Then localStorage.removeItem('mikilab_operator_name') before scrolling to dept-focus-picker if you need a fresh picker. All operator tiles are dept-focus-op-<Name> using exact operator names as returned by /api/depts/assignment (e.g. 'Ali','Marco','Youssef', case-sensitive in testid). Rate-limit note from iter212 still applies (admin-gate/verify 8 per 300s per IP).
rca of the issue: No blocking issue. Sole console anomaly: on switching DeptFocus theme (pizzeria→panificio) THREE emits one 'A WebGL context could not be created. Reason: Canvas has an existing context of a different type' — root cause is AvatarWorld3D reusing the same <canvas> element across theme changes without disposing the previous renderer/context, so when React re-uses the DOM node the requested new context type conflicts. Fix by either (a) keying the canvas by theme so React fully remounts it, or (b) calling renderer.dispose()+renderer.forceContextLoss() in the effect cleanup. The visible 3D strip still paints correctly, so this is P3.
